title: What It Actually Looks Like to Lead Your Friends and Still Be Led
caption:
The guy everyone looks to has a blind spot: nobody tells him no.

The men worth following answer to someone too. A mentor who can call them out. A church they serve in instead of critique. A God they kneel to before they speak for Him.

If you lead your friends, find the man who leads you. Save this and ask yourself who that is.

#faith #godlyman #leadership #humility
